status.en: 25 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Damascus, Aleppo and Quneitra.
status.nb: 25 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Damaskus, Aleppo og Quneitra.

summary.en: Syrian security forces arrested militia leader Mihrac Ural for the 2013 Baniyas massacre and sentenced two individuals to death for the 2025 coastal sectarian violence, while another pair received death sentences for related clashes. A gas export pipeline in northeastern Syria was attacked, sparking a fire. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu disclosed a direct conversation with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa about Druze violence. Qatari and Syrian interior ministers deepened security cooperation in Damascus. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker arresterte militslederen Mihrac Ural for Baniyas-massakren i 2013 og dømte to personer til døden for den sekteriske volden langs kysten i 2025, mens et annet par fikk dødsstraff for relaterte sammenstøt. En gasseksportpipeline i nordøstlige Syria ble angrepet, noe som førte til brann. Israels statsminister Netanyahu opplyste om en direkte samtale med Syriens president Ahmed al-Sharaa om drusisk vold. De qatarske og syriske innenriksministrene styrket sikkerhetssamarbeidet i Damaskus. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
